kind: gen_input (the q = +2 oxygen-vacancy cell at the 4Zr representative site of the relaxed x = 0.50 supercell + its fixed-lattice relaxation deck + its potential-writing static deck, and the total electronic-plus-ionic static dielectric deck on the staged 12-atom cell)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L2/ (reproduced 2026-09-06 on reviewer's rulings, commit ef2b641): as-run decks hpc_computations/x050_o95_4Zr/q+2/{relaxB,static}/{INCAR,KPOINTS} and hpc_computations/eps/hf2zr2/dfpt/{INCAR,KPOINTS,POSCAR}; the starting cell is L1's relaxed pristine cell minus site 95 (asserted equal to x050_o95_4Zr/q0/relaxA/POSCAR by reviewer/make_reference.py). Upstream context (the nine representative sites) from 3_reproduction/L1/site_index_map.json.
graded_object: the vacancy cell (the right oxygen removed from the staged relaxed cell, nothing else changed), the two supercell decks' REQUIRED settings (a charged, spin-unpolarised, fixed-lattice relaxation to the pinned force criterion; a static that writes the electrostatic potential at the same electron count), and the dielectric deck's REQUIRED settings (total electronic-plus-ionic response with the existing accepted VASP routes)

structure_match.note: The vacancy start is the supplied pristine cell minus the requested oxygen; the dielectric cell is the supplied cell unchanged. Periodic global translations and atom reordering are allowed through a species-aware bijection; no inversion mapping. The 0.001 A tolerance covers coordinate serialization: translated/reordered POSCARs printed to six decimals differ by at most 1.21e-5 A in the verified fixtures. A relaxed replacement is outside the given-coordinate contract. Existing lattice tolerances remain unchanged.

declared_pins.note: 728 is NOT printed in the prompt: it follows from the charge state q = +2 (printed, the task's definition) and the catalog valences (16 x 10 + 16 x 12 + 63 x 6 = 730 for the neutral cell); graded on the effective value, the VASP default being the neutral count, so an absent NELECT fails. The force criterion 1e-4 eV/A is the paper's own and is printed (declared pin, notes.md). Spin-unpolarised treatment is printed (reviewer ruling (d), 2026-09-06). 92 is the neutral count of the staged 12-atom cell (2 x 10 + 2 x 12 + 8 x 6): the dielectric deck is graded on the effective NELECT so a supercell count copied into it fails; the default (absent) passes.

encut_catalog: graderlib/grader_potcar_vasp54.yaml (Hf_pv 220.334, Zr_sv 229.898, O 400.000 eV); floor 400 eV, REQUIRED-explicit, for all three runs

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

incar_required.note: Each rule is on the EFFECTIVE value (explicit if set, else the VASP default). Only these settings are graded; the per-tag triage is in notes.md.
incar_required.all_runs: ENCUT >= 400 eV explicit; ISMEAR in {-5, 0}; EDIFF <= 1e-5; GGA absent or Pe; ISPIN effectively 1 (default 1 passes, 2 fails: pinned); POSCAR species as listed; k-mesh per-axis floor
incar_required.relax: ISIF effectively in {0, 1, 2} (all fixed-lattice; 3 fails), IBRION in {1, 2, 3}, EDIFFG < 0 with |EDIFFG| <= 1e-4; NSW >= 1; NELECT effectively 728
incar_required.static: NSW effectively 0 or IBRION = -1; LVHAR = .TRUE. or WRT_POTENTIAL output carrying both Hartree and ionic components on a supporting VASP version (6.4.3+ with HDF5); total potential with XC alone and incomplete components fail; NELECT effectively 728
incar_required.dfpt: LEPSILON or LCALCEPS effectively .TRUE. with IBRION in {5, 6, 7, 8}; NSW >= 1 (the IBRION = 8 at NSW = 0 no-op trap, observed on VASP 6.1.0; default 0 fails); NELECT effectively 92 (the neutral cell; default passes)

not_graded: NCORE/NPAR: machine-dependent parallelisation tags, not graded (reviewer ruling 2026-09-11; handbook 5.2)
score: 1 only if all three runs pass their structure match and every REQUIRED check (binary all-primary-pass)

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
